CLAIM: CLM-2026-10001  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-03-14  
POLICY LINE: homeowners  
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0304 ed. 03-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: COVERED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $1,000  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: NONE  
SUMMARY: The loss resulted from a sudden and accidental rupture of a flexible plumbing supply line, which is expressly covered because exclusion E-17 does not apply to such damage [0007 | HO-0304 ed. 03-24 | E-17]. The policy provides a single deductible of $1,000 per water loss occurrence [0013 | HO-0304 ed. 03-24 | Deductible]. The claim amount of $8,500 for drywall, ceiling, and flooring repair is therefore payable less the deductible.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10002  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-04-03  
POLICY LINE: homeowners  
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0304 ed. 03-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $1,000  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-15  
SUMMARY: The loss resulted from river flood water overtopping its bank and entering the insured’s basement and ground floor, which is classified as flood, surface water, or overflow of a body of water and is excluded under E-15 [0005 | HO-0304 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS / E-15]. Because the loss is excluded, the policy does not provide coverage, and the deductible of $1,000 is irrelevant to the denial [0013 | HO-0304 | SECTION I — CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO THIS ENDORSEMENT].

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10003  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-06-02  
POLICY LINE: homeowners  
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0304 ed. 03-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $1,000  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-19  
SUMMARY: The water loss was caused by continuous seepage from a leaking cold-water supply line that had been escaping for approximately three weeks, which triggers exclusion E-19 for “continuous or repeated seepage or leakage … occurring over a period of 14 days or more” and therefore is not covered [structure_aware:HO-0304:HO-0304-ed-03-24.md:0006 | HO-0304 ed. 03-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS / E-19]. The policy’s deductible of $1,000 applies per loss occurrence.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10004  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-02-20  
POLICY LINE: dwelling_fire  
GOVERNING FORM: DP-0110 ed. 02-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $1,500  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-17  
SUMMARY: The loss resulted from a burst supply hose to the washing machine, which is classified as water damage from the discharge, rupture, or burst of a plumbing supply line within the dwelling and is excluded under E-17 of the DP-0110 form [structure_aware:DP-0110:DP-0110-ed-02-24.md:0002 | DP-0110 ed. 02-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS / E-17]. Consequently, the claim is denied despite the policy excess of $1,500.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10005  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-05-09  
POLICY LINE: condo  
GOVERNING FORM: CO-0715 ed. 04-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: COVERED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $250  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: NONE  
SUMMARY: The loss assessment of $3,000 was levied to repair roof damage caused by a windstorm, a peril insured against under SECTION I of the condo policy, and the assessment is not for a deductible, reserves, or routine maintenance, thus it is not excluded under any of the listed codes (E-31, E-32, E-33, E-34) [structure_aware:CO-0715:CO-0715-ed-04-24.md:0002 | CO-0715 ed. 04-24 | SECTION I — LOSS ASSESSMENT COVERAGE]. The policy provides coverage for such assessments with a $250 deductible per loss assessment [structure_aware:CO-0715:CO-0715-ed-04-24.md:0002 | CO-0715 ed. 04-24 | SECTION I — LOSS ASSESSMENT COVERAGE].

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10006  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-01-18  
POLICY LINE: condo  
GOVERNING FORM: CO-0715 ed. 04-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $250  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-31  
SUMMARY: The policy provides loss-assessment coverage up to $50,000 with a $250 deductible per assessment, but only when the assessment results from a direct physical loss to collectively owned property caused by a covered peril [structure_aware:CO-0715:CO-0715-ed-04-24.md:0002 | CO-0715 ed. 04-24 | SECTION I — LOSS ASSESSMENT COVERAGE]. The board’s assessment was levied to fund the association’s master-policy deductible, which is excluded under exclusion code E-31 [structure_aware:CO-0715:CO-0715-ed-04-24.md:0003 | CO-0715 ed. 04-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS APPLICABLE TO LOSS ASSESSMENT / E-31]. Consequently, the claim is denied.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10007  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-04-11  
POLICY LINE: homeowners  
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0304 ed. 03-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $1,000  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-20  
SUMMARY: The loss resulted from a municipal sewer backup that entered the basement through the floor drain during heavy rain, which is excluded under exclusion E-20 for water damage caused by the backup of sewers or drains [structure_aware:HO-0304:HO-0304-ed-03-24.md:0007 | HO-0304 ed. 03-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS / E-20]. No backup endorsement is on file, so the claim is denied despite the presence of mold and the estimated damages.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10008  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-05-27  
POLICY LINE: homeowners  
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0521 ed. 06-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: PARTIAL  
DEDUCTIBLE: $500  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: NONE  
SUMMARY: The policy provides a special limit of $2,500 for loss by theft of jewelry, watches, and precious stones [structure_aware:HO-0521:HO-0521-ed-06-24.md:0004 | HO-0521 ed. 06-24 | B. Other special limits]. The insured’s claim of $6,000 for a diamond ring and gold necklace exceeds this limit, so coverage is limited to the $2,500 special limit. The policy’s deductible of $500 applies per loss occurrence [structure_aware:HO-0304:HO-0304-ed-03-24.md:0013 | HO-0304 ed. 03-24 | SECTION I — CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO THIS ENDORSEMENT]. No exclusions are triggered.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10009  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-07-08  
POLICY LINE: homeowners  
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0608 ed. 01-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: UNDETERMINED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $1,000  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: NONE  
SUMMARY: The loss is a water damage claim reported on 2026-07-08 for $11,000 with a policy excess of $1,000. The policy provides a single deductible per water loss occurrence as stated in the deductible clause of HO-0304 ed. 03-24 [0013 | HO-0304 | SECTION I — CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO THIS ENDORSEMENT]. However, the policy’s coverage for water damage to the dwelling is not included in the provided excerpts, so it is unclear whether the $11,000 loss is covered, partially covered, or excluded. Additional policy language defining coverage for water damage to the dwelling is needed to determine the coverage position.

CLAIM: CLM-2026-10010  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-03-02  
POLICY LINE: condo  
GOVERNING FORM: CO-0715 ed. 04-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: DENIED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $250  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: E-33  
SUMMARY: The association’s assessment of $4,200 arises from water damage to the collectively owned cold-water riser, which the association failed to maintain, triggering exclusion E-33 for assessments resulting from maintenance failure of plumbing [0005 | CO-0715 ed. 04-24 | SECTION I — EXCLUSIONS APPLICABLE TO LOSS ASSESSMENT / E-33]. Because the loss is excluded, the claim is denied and the $250 assessment deductible is not applied.

CLAIM: CLAIM_ID  
DATE OF LOSS: 2026-04-03  
POLICY LINE: homeowners  
GOVERNING FORM: HO-0304 ed. 03-24  
COVERAGE POSITION: COVERED  
DEDUCTIBLE: $750  
EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: NONE  
SUMMARY: The loss is a water damage claim arising from rain intrusion through a plastic sheet covering a roof decking opening, which is a covered peril under the homeowners policy. The policy provides a single deductible of $750 per water loss occurrence, which applies to this claim [structure_aware:HO-0304:HO-0304-ed-03-24.md:0013 | HO-0304 ed. 03-24 | SECTION I — CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO THIS ENDORSEMENT]. No applicable exclusion codes are triggered by the facts of this loss.
